applicability: CLT-based aggregate test-suite runtime timeout budget from declared per-test mean/std duration and test count
assumptions: individual test durations are independent random variables
test durations are approximately normally distributed at the aggregate (sum) level
uncertainty: Standard application of the Central Limit Theorem (variance of independent random variables adds); hand-verified before use (mean=2s,std=0.5s,n=100,k=3 -> total_mean=200s, total_std=5s, timeout=215s).
limits_policy: A recommended timeout exceeding the declared maximum allowed budget is flagged rather than silently accepted.
